theorems.name: Submission.codim1_lura_gram_det_comp_orthonormal
theorems.statement: ∀ (m d P : ℕ) (Λ : Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid d), (Injective Λ → 0 < Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin m => inner ℝ (Λ (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (Λ (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))) ∧ ∀ (Γ : Euclid d →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (σ : Fin m → Euclid d), Orthonormal ℝ σ → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range σ) = LinearMap.range (Λ : Euclid m →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid d) → Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin m => inner ℝ (Γ (Λ (EuclideanSpace.single k 1))) (Γ (Λ (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))) = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin m => inner ℝ (Γ (σ i)) (Γ (σ j))) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin m => inner ℝ (Λ (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (Λ (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))
